chunks.sanskrit: ā vā̍yo bhūṣa śucipā̠ upa̍ naḥ sa̠hasraṃ̍ te ni̠yuto̍ viśvavāra|
upo̍ te̠ andho̠ madya̍mayāmi̠ yasya̍ deva dadhi̠ṣe pū̎rva̠peya̎m||
pra yābhi̠ryāsi̍ dā̠śvāgͫ samacchā̍ ni̠yudbhi̍rvāyavi̠ṣṭaye̍ duro̠ṇe|
ni no̍ ra̠yigͫ su̠bhoja̍saym̐yuve̠ha ni vī̠rava̠dgavya̠maśvi̍yaṃ ca̠ rādhaḥ̍||
pra vā̠yumacchā̍ bṛha̠tī ma̍nī̠ṣā bṛ̠hadra̍yivm̐vi̠śvavā̍rāgͫ ratha̠prām|
yat kā̍māste juhu̠mastanno̍ astu va̠yagͫͫ syā̍ma̠ pata̍yo rayī̠ṇām||
tave̠me lo̠kāḥ pra̠diśo̠ diśa̍śca pa̠rā̠vato̍ ni̠vata̍ u̠dvata̍śca|
pra̠jāpa̍tiḥ prathama̠jā ṛ̠tasya̍ sa̠hasra̍dhāmā juṣatāgͫ ha̠virnaḥ̍||
rā̠yaspoṣa̠vm̐viṣya̍tāṃ̠ nābhi̍ma̠sme dhiyaṃ̍ pū̠ṣā ji̍nvatu viśvami̠nvaḥ|
aci̍ttī̠yat tava̠ dharmā̍ yuyopi̠ma mā na̠stasmā̠ dena̍so deva rīriṣaḥ||
ki̠ta̠vāso̠ yadri̍ ri̠purna dī̠vi yadvā̍ ghā sa̠tya mu̠tayanna vi̠dma|
sarvā̠ tā viṣya̍ śithi̠reva̍ de̠vāthā̍ te syāma varuṇa pri̠yāsaḥ̍||
ava̍ te̠ heḍo̍ varuṇa̠ namo̍bhi̠rava̍ ya̠jñebhi̍rīmahe ha̠virbhiḥ̍|
a̠nā̠gā̠stve a̍diti̠tve tu̠rāsa̍ i̠maym̐ya̠jñaṃ da̍dhatu̠ śroṣa̍māṇāḥ||
na da̍khṣi̠ṇā vici̍kite̠ na sa̠vyā na prā̠cīna̍mādityā̠ nota pa̠ścā|
pā̠kyā̍ cidvasavo dhī̠ryā̍ cid yu̠ṣmānī̍to̠ abha̍yaṃ̠ jyoti̍raśyām||
dhā̠raya̍nta ādi̠tyāso̠ jaga̠thsthā de̠vā viśva̍sya̠ bhuva̍nasya go̠pāḥ|
ti̠sro bhūmī̎rdhāraya̠n trīgͫ ru̠ta dyūn trīṇi̍ vra̠tā vi̠dathe̍ a̠ntare̍ṣām|
ṛ̠tenā̍''dityā̠ mahi̍ vo mahi̠tvaṃ tada̍ryaman varuṇa mitra̠ cāru̍||
ā̠di̠tyāsaḥ̍ pa̠thibhi̍rdeva̠yānaiḥ̎ a̠sme kāmaṃ̍ dā̠śuṣe̍ sa̠nnama̍ntaḥ|
stī̠rṇaṃ ba̠ra̠hirha̍vi̠radyā̍ya de̠vāḥ stī̠rṇaṃ ba̠ra̠hiḥ sī̍datā ya̠jñe a̠sminn|
ha̠vyaṃ ma̠tiṃ cā̠gnaye̠ supū̍tam yo daivyā̍ni̠ mānu̍ṣā ja̠nūgͫṣi̍|
khṣāvm̐viśve̍bhira̠jare̍bhiryajatra agne̠ tvaṃ pā̍rayā̠ navyo̍ a̠smān|
indraṃ̠ naro̍ ne̠madhi̍tā havante̠ yatpāryā̍ yu̠naja̍te̠ dhiya̠stāḥ|
śūro̠ nṛṣā̍tā̠ śava̍saścakā̠na ā goma̍ti vra̠je bha̍jā̠ tvannaḥ̍||
ja̠gṛ̠bhṇā te̠ dakhṣi̍ṇāmindra̠ hasta̎m va̠sū̠yavo̍ vasupate̠ vasū̍nām|
vi̠dmā hi tvā̠ gopa̍tigͫ śūra̠ gonā̎m|
saṃ brahma̍ṇā de̠vakṛ̍ta̠ym̐yadasti̍ saṃ de̠vānā̍gͫ suma̠tyā ya̠jñiyā̍nām||
bṛha̍spate̠ pari̍ dīyā̠ rathe̍na rakhṣo̠hā'mitrā̍gͫ apa̠ bādha̍mānaḥ|
pra̠bhaṃ̠janth senāḥ̎ pramṛ̠ṇo yu̠dhā jaya̍nna̠smāka̍medhyavi̠tā rathā̍nām||
ā no̍ di̠vo bṛ̍ha̠taḥ parva̍tā̠dā sara̍svatī yaja̠tā ga̍ntu ya̠jñam|
havaṃ̍ de̠vī ju̍juṣā̠ṇā ghṛ̠tācī̍ śa̠gmāṃ no̠ vāca̍muśa̠tī śṛ̍ṇotu||
pāvī̍ravī ka̠nyā̍ ci̠trāyuḥ̠ sara̍svatī vī̠rapa̍tnī̠ dhiyaṃ̍ dhāt|
gnābhi̠racchi̍dragͫ śara̠ṇagͫ sa̠joṣā̍ durā̠dharṣaṃ̍ gṛṇa̠te śarma̍ yagͫsat||
usra̍ gha̠rmagͫ śi̠g̠ͫṣosra̍ gha̠rmam pā̍hi gha̠rmāya̍ śi̠g̠ͫṣetyā̍ha|
mā pa̍spharīḥ̠ paya̍sā̠ mā na̠ ā dha̍k|
yā te̠ dhāmā̍ni ha̠viṣā̠ yaja̍nti̠ tā te̠ viśvā̍ pari̠bhūra̍stu ya̠jñaṃ ga̍ya̠sphānaḥ̍ pra̠tara̍ṇaḥ su̠vīro'vī̍rahā̠ praca̍rā soma̠ duryā̠na "suvi̠te mā̍ dhāḥ ||
tvaṃ jyoti̍ṣā̠ vitamo̍ vavartha yā te̠ dhāmā̍ni di̠vi yā pṛ̍thi̠vyām|

viṣṇo̠rnuka̍vm̐vī̠ryā̍ṇi̠ pra vo̍ca̠ym̐yaḥ pārthi̍vāni vima̠me rajā̍gͫsi̠ yo aska̍bhāya̠dutta̍ragͫ sa̠dhastha̍vm̐vicakramā̠ṇa stre̠dhoru̍gā̠yo viṣṇo̍ ra̠rāṭa̍masi̠ viṣṇoḥ̎ pṛ̠ṣṭhama̍si̠ viṣṇoḥ̠ śnyaptre̎ stho̠ viṣṇoḥ̠ syūra̍si̠ viṣṇo̎r dhru̠vama̍si vaiṣṇa̠vama̍si̠ viṣṇa̍ve tvā||
u̠bhe te̍ vidma̠ raja̍sī pṛthi̠vyā viṣṇo̍ deva̠ tvam|
a̠bhi go̠trāṇi̠ saha̍sā̠ gāha̍māno'dā̠yo vī̠raḥ śa̠tama̍nyu̠rindraḥ̍|
du̠ścya̠va̠naḥ pṛ̍tanā̠ṣāḍa̍ yu̠dhyo̎smāka̠g̠ͫ senā̍ avatu̠ pra yu̠thsu||
ya̠dā sa̠tyaṃ kṛ̍ṇu̠te ma̠nyumindraḥ̍ viśvaṃ̍ dṛ̠ḍhaṃ bha̍yata̠ eja̍dasmāt||
jani̍ṣṭhā u̠graḥ saha̍se tu̠rāya̍ ma̠ndra oji̍ṣṭho bahu̠lābhi̍mānaḥ|
ma̠rudbhi̍rindra sa̠khyaṃ te̍ astu athe̠mā viśvāḥ̠ pṛta̍nā jayāsi||
indro̍ vṛ̠trama̍taradvṛtra̠tūrye̎ a̠nā̠dhṛ̠ṣyo ma̠ghavā̠ śūra̠ indraḥ̍|
sa e̠va vī̠raḥ sa u̍ vī̠ryā̍vān|
vṛ̠traṃ tī̠rtvā dā̍na̠vavm̐vajra̍bāhuḥ diśo̍'dṛgͫ haddṛgͫhi̠tā dṛgͫha̍ṇena||
pu̠ro̠ḍāśa̍sya juṣatāgͫ ha̠virnaḥ̍ ha̠tvā'bhimā̍tīḥ̠ pṛta̍nāḥ̠ saha̍svān|
a̠smabhyaṃ̍ ci̠travm̐vṛṣa̍ṇagͫ ra̠yiṃ dā̎t ya i̠me dyāvā̍pṛthi̠vī ma̍hi̠tvā|
ana̍vaste̠ ratha̠maśvā̍ya takhṣa̠ntvaṣṭā̠ vajraṃ̍ puruhūta dyu̠manta̎m|
bra̠hmāṇa̠ indraṃ̍ ma̠haya̍nto a̠rkairava̍rddhaya̠nnaha̍ye̠ hanta̠ vā u̍||
vṛṣṇe̠ yat te̠ vṛṣa̍ṇo a̠rkamarcā̠nindra̠ grāvā̍ṇo̠ adi̍tiḥ sa̠joṣāḥ̎|
a̠na̠śvāso̠ ye pa̠vayo̍'ra̠thā indre̍ṣitā a̠bhyava̍rttaṃta̠ dasyū̍n||
a̠rānna ne̠miḥ pari̠tā ba̍bhūva a̠bhi si̠ddhmo a̍jigādasya̠ śatrū̍n|
viṣṇuṃ̍ ca de̠vavm̐varu̍ṇaṃ ca rā̠tim tā no̠ amī̍vā apa̠bādha̍mānau|
viṣṇū̍ aga̠nvaru̍ṇā pū̠rvahū̍tau viṣṇū̍varuṇā vabhiśasti̠pā vā̎m|
ru̠cā bha̍vatāgͫ śu̠caya̍dbhira̠rkaiḥ yathsī̠vm̐vari̍ṣṭhe bṛha̠tī vi̍mi̠nvann|
a̠va̠g̠ͫśe dhīraḥ̠ śacyā̠ samai̍rat bhūriṃ̠ dve aca̍rantī̠ cara̍ntam|
mandā̍mi ba̠bhrūṇā̍ma̠hagͫ śa̠taṃ dhāmā̍ni sa̠pta ca̍||
śnatha̍dvṛ̠tramu̠ta sa̍noti̠ vāja̠mindrā̠ yo a̠gnī sahu̍rī sapa̠ryāt|
i̠ra̠jyantā̍ vasa̠vya̍sya̠ bhūreḥ̠ saha̍stamā̠ saha̍sā vāja̠yantā̎||
u̠bhā vā̍mindrāgnī āhu̠vadhyā̍ u̠bhā rādha̍saḥ sa̠ha mā̍da̠yadhyai̎|
u̠bhā dā̠tārā̍vi̠ṣāgͫ ra̍yī̠ṇāmu̠bhā vāja̍sya sā̠taye̍ huve vām||
yo gā u̠dāja̠thsa di̠ve vi cā̍bhajat|
brahma̍ṇaspate su̠yama̍sya vi̠śvahā̎ rā̠yaḥ syā̍ma ra̠thyo̍ viva̍svataḥ|
sa ijjane̍na̠ sa vi̠śā sa janma̍nā|
pū̠ṣemā āśā̠ anu̍veda̠ sarvāḥ̎ so a̠smāgͫ abha̍yatamena neṣat|
prapa̍the pa̠thāma̍janiṣṭa pū̠ṣā prapa̍the di̠vaḥ prapa̍the pṛthi̠vyāḥ|
ā ca̠ parā̍ ca carati prajā̠nann||
aṣṭrāṃ̎ pū̠ṣā śi̍thi̠rāmu̠dvarī̍vṛjat sa̠caṃkhṣā̍ṇo̠ bhuva̍nā de̠va ī̍yate||
agͫse̠ṣvā ma̍rutaḥ khā̠dayo̍ vaḥ vakhṣaḥ̍su ru̠kmā upa̍śiśriyā̠ṇāḥ|
i̠me śagͫsa̍vm̐vanuṣya̠to nipā̎nti gu̠rudveṣo̠ ara̍ruṣe dadhanti||
ya indra̠ śuṣmo̍ maghavante̠ asti̍ śikhṣā̠ sakhi̍bhyaḥ puruhūta̠ nṛbhyaḥ̍|
ā te̠ śuṣmo̍ vṛṣa̠bha etu̍ pa̠ścāt|
ka̠ta̠māṃ dyāgͫ ra̠śmira̠syāta̍tāna bhagaṃ̠ dhiya̍vm̐vā̠jaya̍ntaḥ̠ pura̍ndhim|
ā no̠ viśve̠ askrā̍ gamantu de̠vāḥ|
śagͫ sara̍svatī sa̠ha dhī̠bhira̍stu śama̍bhi̠ṣācaḥ̠ śamu̍ rāti̠ṣācaḥ̍|
śaṃ no̍ di̠vyāḥ pārthi̍vāḥ̠ śaṃ no̠ apyāḥ̎||
ya̠khṣi̠ de̠vān ra̍tna̠dheyā̍ya̠ viśvā̍n dyauḥ pi̍taḥ̠ pṛthi̍vi̠ māta̠raddhru̍k|
ye a̠ntari̍khṣe̠ ya upa̠ dyavi̠ ṣṭha|
nama̍sā devā̠ vava̍sā''vavṛtyām a̠smākaṃ̠ brahma̠ pṛta̍nāsu sahyā a̠smāka̎m|
anu̍ vā̠mekaḥ̍ pa̠virāva̍varti yadbagͫhi̍ṣṭhaṃ̠ nāti̠vide̍ sudānū|
ā no̠ gavyū̍timukhṣataṃ ghṛ̠tena̍ ā no̠ jane̎ śravayataym̐yuvānā|
mā na̍sto̠ke tana̍ye̠ mā na̠ āyu̍ṣi̠ mā no̠ goṣu̠ mā no̠ aśve̍ṣu rīriṣaḥ|
vī̠rān māno̍ rudra bhāmi̠to va̍dhīrha̠viṣma̍nto̠ nama̍sā vidhema te||
yathā̍ deva̠ na hṛ̍ṇī̠ṣe na hagͫsi̍|
pari̍ṇo ru̠drasya̍ he̠ti rvṛ̍ṇaktu̠ pari̍tve̠ṣasya̍ durma̠tira̍ghā̠yoḥ|
ava̍ sthi̠rā ma̠ghava̍dbhyastanuṣva̠ mīḍhva̍sto̠kāya̠ tana̍yāya mṛḍaya||
tvama̍gne ru̠dro asu̍ro ma̠ho di̠vastvagͫ śarddho̠ māru̍taṃ pṛ̠khṣa ī̍śiṣe|
tvavm̐vātai̍raru̠ṇairyā̍si śaṃga̠yastvaṃ pū̠ṣā vi̍dha̠taḥ pā̍si̠ nutmanā̎||
ā vo̠ rājā̍namadhva̠rasya̍ ru̠dragͫ hotā̍ragͫ satya̠yaja̠g̠ͫ roda̍syoḥ|
ma̠ddhyā karto̠rvita̍ta̠g̠ͫ saṃja̍bhāra ya̠dedayu̍kta ha̠ritaḥ̍ sa̠dhasthā̎t|
adi̍tiḥ̠ sindhuḥ̍ pṛthi̠vī u̠ta dyauḥ di̠vo ru̠kma u̍ru̠cakhṣā̠ ude̍ti|
śaṃ no̍ bhava̠ cakhṣa̍sā̠ śaṃ no̠ ahnā̎|
śaṃ bhā̠nunā̠ śagͫ hi̠mā śaṃ ghṛ̠ṇena̍|
tanna̍stu̠rīpa̠madha̍ poṣayi̠tnu deva̍ tvaṣṭa̠rvi ra̍rā̠ṇaḥ sya̍sva|
yato̍ vī̠raḥ ka̍rma̠ṇyaḥ̍ su̠dakhṣo̍ yu̠ktagrā̍vā̠ jāya̍te de̠vakā̍maḥ||
tvaṣṭā̍ vī̠raṃ de̠vakā̍maṃ jajāna̠ tvaṣṭu̠rarvā̍ jāyata ā̠śuraśvaḥ̍|
tvaṣṭe̠davm̐viśvaṃ̠ bhuva̍naṃ jajāna ba̠hoḥ ka̠rtāra̍mi̠ha ya̍khṣi hotaḥ||
pi̠śaṅga̍rūpaḥ su̠bharo̍ vayo̠dhāḥ śru̠ṣṭī vī̠ro jā̍yate de̠vakā̍maḥ|
pra̠jāṃ tvaṣṭā̠ viṣya̍tu̠ nābhi̍ma̠sme athā̍ de̠vānā̠mapye̍tu̠ pāthaḥ̍||
mi̠tro janā̍n yātayati prajā̠nan mi̠tro dā̍dhāra pṛthi̠vīmu̠ta dyām|
mi̠traḥ kṛ̠ṣṭīrani̍miṣā̠'bhi ca̍ṣṭe sa̠tyāya̍ ha̠vyaṃ ghṛ̠tava̍dvidhema||
pra sa mi̍tra̠ marto̍ astu̠ praya̍svā̠n yasta̍ āditya̠ śikhṣa̍ti vra̠tena̍|
na ha̍nyate̠ na jī̍yate̠ tvoto̠ naina̠magͫho̍ aśno̠tyanti̍to̠ na dū̠rāt||
ā̠di̠tyasya̍ vra̠tamu̍pa̠khṣyantaḥ̍ va̠yaṃ mi̠trasya̍ suma̠tau syā̍ma||
mi̠traṃ na īgͫ śimyā̠ goṣu̍ ga̠vyava̍t|
āvā̠g̠ͫ ratho̠ roda̍sī badbadhā̠naḥ hi̠ra̠ṇyayo̠ vṛṣa̍bhiryā̠tvaśvaiḥ̎|
vi vā̠g̠ͫ ratho̍ va̠ddhvā̍ yāda̍mānaḥ antā̎n di̠vo bā̍dhate varta̠nibhyā̎m||
yo ha̠ sya vā̍gͫ rathirā̠ vasta̍ u̠srāḥ|
tasya̍ vra̠tagͫ ra̍khṣataṃ pā̠tamagͫha̍saḥ vi̠śe janā̍ya̠ mahi̠ śarma̍ yacchatam||
